t: Versatile DeWalt DCK2060M2T-SFGB 18V twin pack containing combi drill and impact driver to deliver reliable cordless performance with brushless motor technology. The combi drill provides 65Nm max torque, and features 15-position clutch which includes screwdriving, drill driving and hammer settings for a wide range of applications, and the compact, lightweight impact driver delivers 170Nm—ideal for high-torque fixings in tight spaces. Both tools feature all-metal gearboxes with aluminium front housing, offering heat dispersion for increased durability and bright white LED work lights to improve visibility. Drop-in keyless hex driver allows for quick, one-handed fitment. Supplied with 2 x 4.0Ah XR Li-Ion batteries, a 100-minute multi-voltage charger, and a stackable TSTAK case for easy site transport.
